title: Brand New Key: A Tarragon Tequila Cocktail
ldName: Brand New Key: A Tarragon Tequila Cocktail
ldInstructionsRaw:
Add all the ingredients to the shaker with ice. Shake and fine strain into a chilled glass. Garnish.
Tarragon-Infused Reposado TequilaAdd 3 sprigs of tarragon to a 750ml bottle of reposado tequila and allow to sit for 24 hours. Strain it. Note: Taste before straining; it can go another 12-24 hours if needed.
